name: vigileye-ai
description: Root runner for VigilEye AI — starts website, backend, and ml-model together.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix website && npm install --prefix backend && pip install -r ml-model/service/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: node print-routes.js && concurrently -n website,backend,ml-model -c blue,green,yellow --prefix-colors auto "npm run dev --prefix website" "npm run start:dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev:ml"
scripts.train:ml: cd ml-model/training && python train.py --data dataset.yaml --base-model yolo11n.pt --epochs 20 --img 640 --batch 8 --no-wandb
scripts.pipeline:ml: npm run train:ml && npm run eval:ml && npm run export:ml
